attBesluta.text: excellent product for price sized as stated very happy

This was better then I expected. Good quality materials and performed really well. VEVOR knocked it out of the park on this one. Even better what tied it all together as a great product was the price compared to others was amazing.
Good sealed box to hold my straps, it is light duty metal but bolted down to my trailer it does what I need.
Passt perfekt auf mein 750kg hänger an die Deichsel. Qualität ist auch okay, würde ich wieder kaufen.
Just what I needed for my flatbed trailer to keep straps and tie downs in!!!
